summary: WebSocket-controlled PTY/shell exposes installer host to remote code execution
details: On startup, @yeaft/webchat-agent connects to a WebSocket server (default ws://localhost:3456, overridable via SERVER_URL or.claude-agent.json) and processes messages that spawn a native PTY (bash on Unix, powershell/cmd on Windows) and write incoming message.data directly into it via terminal.js (pty.spawn(shell,...) followed by term.pty.write(msg.data), dispatched from message-router.js handleTerminalInput). The same peer can read, write, and delete arbitrary files, run git operations against the host, and trigger a self-upgrade (`upgrade_agent` message causes execFile of npm to install @yeaft/webchat-agent@latest and respawn under systemd/launchd/PM2). Whoever controls the WebSocket endpoint the operator points the agent at obtains full command execution on the host running the agent. Loading index.js also runs `npm install` in the package directory when node_modules is missing and performs `git clone`/`git pull --ff-only` of https://github.com/yeaft/yeaft-skills.git into ~/.claude/plugins/marketplaces/, and modifies ~/.claude/settings.json and related plugin config files on every require.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
